def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct) or app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType')
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(des)
    body = des.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    for i, f in enumerate(body.faces):
        g = f.geometry
        if g.surfaceType == adsk.core.SurfaceTypes.CylinderSurfaceType:
            o = g.origin; ax = g.axis
            print(i, 'cyl r=%.4f' % (g.radius*10), 'origin=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f)' % (o.x*10,o.y*10,o.z*10), 'axis=(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f)' % (ax.x,ax.y,ax.z))

    # Rough around pin: clear everything outside pin top circle, down to shoulder z=6.35 (6.35 deep + 1mm stock above)
    r = mb.add_operation('Setup1', strategy='adaptive2d', tool=1,
                         geometry={'faces': [8], 'type': 'pocket', 'side': 'outside'},
                         name='RoughPin')
    print(r['operation'])

def run(_context):
    # Rough around pin down to shoulder (pin top z=12.7 model, shoulder z=6.35 -> 6.35 deep)
    mb.set_params('RoughPin', {
        'tool_spindleSpeed': {'value': 2500, 'unit': 'raw'},
        'tool_feedCutting': {'value': 500, 'unit': 'mm'},
        'bottomHeight_mode': {'value': "'from contour'", 'unit': 'choice'},
        'bottomHeight_offset': {'value': -6.35, 'unit': 'mm'},
        'maximumStepdown': {'value': 3.5, 'unit': 'mm'},

        'stockToLeave': {'value': 0.5, 'unit': 'mm'},

    })
    print(mb.generate(operation='RoughPin'))
